dashboard.platformStatus.title: Platform status
dashboard.platformStatus.unreachable: The billing platform is not responding.
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you asked for does not exist.
login.title: Sign in
login.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
enrol.intro: Two-factor authentication is required. Scan this with your authenticator app.
enrol.manualHint: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually instead:
enrol.code: Enter the code your app shows
enrol.qrFailed: The QR code could not be drawn. Use the key below instead.
recovery.warning: These codes are shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
recovery.intro: Save these somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator.
enrol.done: Two-factor authentication is on. Sign in again to finish.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email address you sign in with. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires shortly.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Pick a password you do not use anywhere else.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.deadLinkBody: The link is incomplete, already used, or has expired. Ask for a new one.
reset.doneBody: You have been signed out everywhere else. Sign in again with your new password.
appError.title: This page could not be loaded
appError.description: The app may have been updated since you opened this tab. Reloading usually fixes it.
